message:
feat(api): versioned v1 API with server-side search

The competitor's API is a single 498 KB file with no CORS header, string
values, no per-item lookup, no search and no documentation. Ours:

- /api/v1/ discovery document, versioned from the VERSION file
- /api/v1/items.json - every item, numbers not strings, sorted by value
- /api/v1/items/<slug>.json - one item with history, rolls and related items
- /api/v1/items/<slug>/history.json - price series with 7d/30d change
- /api/v1/categories.json + categories/<slug>/items.json - English slugs
- /api/v1/changes.json - biggest gainers and losers
- /api/v1/stats.json - market summary
- /api/v1/search-index.json - 48 KB index for instant client-side search
- /api/v1/openapi.json - OpenAPI 3.1 spec
- /api/v1/docs.html - human readable reference
- /api/v1/search - server-side search function (Vercel), with query
  parameters, sorting, pagination and Russian category aliases

687 files, 1.69 MB total. Single item fetch is 3.2 KB against the competitor's
498 KB for anything at all.
author: BSS Index Developer
